flags.description: In the Xu source-data files, the plotted bar values do not always equal the means of the listed replicates. Against the COMPLETE replicate arrays: bars agree with the replicate mean within 0.5 pp for 47 of 139 records (library median |delta| 0.80 pp, secondary median 1.25 pp, max 5.8 pp). The bars are the authors' own plotted summary; the replicate spread is real (n=3-5, small-group in vivo editing). Records keep the plotted bar as primary (extracted_from_table) and preserve replicates; the caveat is in efficacy.value_basis.
flags.evidence: Pass 2 recomputed replicate means from the complete source arrays for all 139 screen records.
flags.recommendation: None required for the primary values (bars are the authors' summary). For Pass 3 ML use: treat screen bars within ~2 pp of class cutoffs as uncertain; the label_for_ml classes (high>30, medium 10-30, low<10) are robust to these deltas except for borderline records.

flags.description: Pass 2 recomputed all 16 Hofstraat in vivo knockdown values from the publisher source-data file (MOESM6, Fig. 3g sheet, normalized gMFI block) using the documented formula (1 - mean normalized siLAMP1 gMFI) x 100. 15 of 16 reproduce exactly (within 0.05). The single mismatch is aNP72 LT-HSC: recorded -2.4 vs verified +5.7 (n=6 normalized replicates: 0.75, 0.91, 1.15, 0.86, 1.45, 0.54). The recorded -2.4 is exactly reproduced only when the 6th replicate (0.54) is dropped (mean of remaining 5 = 1.024). Pass 1 apparently used 5 of 6 replicates for this one cell subset.
flags.evidence: 41565_2024_1847_MOESM6_ESM.xlsx sheet g (Europe PMC supplementary package for PMC12014499), normalized gMFI block, recomputed 2026-09-06
flags.impact: Both values round to the same conclusion (no LT-HSC effect) and label_for_ml stays low. The negative value was the basis for the audit-exception decision; the exception policy remains correct as a rule, but this specific value does not reproduce from source data.
flags.recommendation: Correct efficacy.knockdown_percent_LT_HSC to 5.7 with provenance updated to n=6, or document a justified replicate exclusion. Needs user decision because it reverses a value covered by a prior user decision.
flags.not_auto_fixed_because: hard rule: values that conflict with a user decision are flagged, not silently repaired
flags.resolution: Corrected on 2026-09-06 with user verification. aNP72 siCtrl (aNP72-) normalized gMFI is 1.1, 1.17, 1.04, 1.0, 0.69 (mean 1.000); siLAMP1 (aNP72+) is 0.75, 0.91, 1.15, 0.86, 1.45, 0.54 (mean 0.943). KD = (1 - 0.943/1.000) x 100 = 5.7%. Record efficacy.knockdown_percent_LT_HSC updated -2.4 -> 5.7 with value_basis_LT_HSC documenting the computation. Record stays low class. The negative-knockdown audit exception remains as a general rule for genuinely negative computed values.
